completeness.why: getDateWithSkippedWeekend now takes the enable flag, and the upcoming-dates and both template sites just pass their own skipWeekend and mode fields (the template's day-string parse/format is its own data handling). getNextDate still works out the flag itself with skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend; the shared definition does not name the noSkipWeekend override, so whether the rule applies is still partly decided at that site. Between full and partial, so scored partial.

interface.why: One added enable flag is the real variation and each caller maps its own mode field, but it is a positional boolean that defaults to true (callers that forget it silently keep the rule on), and the noSkipWeekend override is folded into a caller expression instead of being made explicit.

disguised_duplication.where: The call-site ternaries are removed in favour of the shared helper, not reshaped.
